A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Latent Wavelet Diffusion (LWD). Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–E are readable and support reliable comparison despite the revised title and formatting.

before.justification: v1 reports original 2K/4K generation experiments, frequency analyses, and VAE reconstruction ablations in Tables 1–5, alongside generated-image comparisons.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and qualitative results and adds a Diffusion-4K result row to Table 1.

M1.justification: The scale-consistent VAE objective, wavelet-energy saliency construction, time-dependent masking, and masked flow-matching loss remain unchanged. Section 3 contains wording refinements without changing the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain Aesthetic-4K/Aesthetic-Eval, LAION-High-Res, and HPD prompts for the same 2K/4K synthesis and reconstruction tasks. No additional dataset, domain, or test scenario is evaluated.

E2.justification: v3 adds Diffusion-4K to the HPD 2048×2048 comparison in Table 1. Although its SD3-Diff4k-F16 variant already appeared in other comparisons in v1, participation in this particular comparison is new. Other comparator sets are retained.

E3.justification: Reported dataset sample counts, resolutions, metrics, training iterations, batch sizes, and learning rate are unchanged. Appendix C.2 newly documents selection of retained qualitative examples; it does not establish a revised experimental procedure.

E4.justification: The latent-spectrum analysis in Figure 3, frequency-sensitive evaluation in Appendix D/Table 4, and scale-consistency reconstruction ablation in Appendix E/Table 5 are retained. The qualitative examples also match, with no added robustness or sensitivity analysis.

E5.justification: Appendix C.2 newly states that qualitative comparisons use a fixed random seed shared between each baseline and LWD model. This adds seed information, without supplying the seed value or establishing additional runs. Other uncertainty reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 1 newly reports Diffusion-4K results: FID 37.10, LPIPS 0.6920, MAN-IQA 0.3550, QualiCLIP 0.4815, HPSv2.1 30.55, and PickScore 22.80. Existing Table 1 rows, Tables 2–5, and qualitative examples are unchanged, including LWD's reported performance.

T1.justification: Equations 1–7, Appendix A's wavelet and relevance-map definitions, and Appendix D's frequency-metric definitions are retained. No mathematical correction, new derivation, theorem, or proof is introduced.

C1.justification: The title drops 'Enabling 4K Image Synthesis for Free.' The abstract replaces the broad claim of scaling any latent diffusion model 'for free' with a training-framework description and explicitly confines zero additional cost to inference. The principal quality and compatibility claims remain.

C2.justification: The frequency-supervision interpretation, Appendix B's explanation of spectral regularization, and Section 4.4's VAE-compression limitation retain their meaning. The added ethics discussion and subjective-preference caveat are generic qualifications rather than new scientific interpretations or specific failure conditions.

D1.justification: Appendix C.2 newly documents prompt provenance and first-output selection. Section 6 states that supplementary masking code is supplied and specifies planned training/evaluation code and checkpoints; Section 7 adds a proposed release-license policy. Neither PDF contains the claimed script, so its availability cannot be verified from the supplied material.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning are retained, including the distinction between Diffusion-4K's uniform wavelet losses and LWD's spatially and temporally selective supervision. Author-year citations and added bibliographic URLs or metadata do not introduce new related work.

P1.justification: v3 rewrites the title and abstract, lightly edits methodology and evaluation prose, adds reproducibility and ethics sections, and adds the Appendix C.2 selection paragraph. Most prose and the main scientific section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 adopts conference headers and typography, adjusts table sizing for author-year citations and the added Table 1 row, and relocates Figure 5 ahead of Table 2. All thirteen figures retain their substantive visual content; other changes mainly involve page reflow.

improvement.justification: The clearer inference-cost claim, added relevant Diffusion-4K comparison, and explicit qualitative selection and seed disclosure modestly improve precision and evaluation transparency. The method and existing evidence remain unchanged, and the reproducibility statement does not provide verifiable code within the PDFs, limiting the overall gain.
